Meta.title: Tiefer | Edge AI in orbit
Meta.description: Tiefer builds AI software that runs on Earth observation satellites: it filters useless pixels in orbit, detects events on board and sends kilobyte-sized alerts instead of gigabytes of raw imagery. Built in Baku.

Hero.title: See deeper.
Hero.lead: Tiefer builds AI software that runs on Earth observation satellites. It filters out useless pixels in orbit, detects events on board, and sends kilobyte-sized alerts to the ground instead of gigabytes of raw imagery.

Problem.label: 01 / PROBLEM
Problem.title: Satellites see more than they can send.
Problem.intro: An Earth observation satellite stores what it captures and sends it down only when it passes over a ground station. By the time the image is processed, a fire has spread or a spill has drifted. And about two thirds of Earth's surface is under cloud at any moment, so much of what is sent is never useful.

delay.title: Hours of delay
delay.text: Images wait on board for the next ground contact, then wait again for processing.

downlink.title: Wasted downlink
downlink.text: Cloudy and empty frames use the same scarce bandwidth as the ones that matter.

passive.title: Passive cameras
passive.text: The satellite captures everything and understands nothing until humans look.

Product.label: 02 / PRODUCT
Product.title: Four stages. One onboard system.
Product.body: The four lines in our logo are the four stages Tiefer runs on the satellite. Each can be tested on its own. Together they turn a camera into an analyst.

filter.name: FILTER
filter.text: Checks every frame for cloud and quality as it is captured. Useless frames are compressed and kept, not sent.

detect.name: DETECT
detect.text: Runs computer vision models for the events that matter: fires, oil spills, vessels, floods.

alert.name: ALERT
alert.text: Sends a small packet with location, event type, confidence and an image chip through the first available link.

update.name: UPDATE
update.text: New or better models reach orbit as small, signed updates. No new satellite needed.

Product.note: Tiefer is software. It runs on the onboard compute operators already fly: GPU, VPU or FPGA.

How.label: 03 / HOW IT WORKS
How.title: From capture to alert, on board

filter.title: Filter
filter.text: Cloudy or empty? Compress and keep on board.

detect.title: Detect
detect.text: Useful frame? Run the event models.

alert.title: Alert
alert.text: Event found? Build a small alert packet.

downlink.title: Downlink
downlink.text: Send it through the first available channel to the operator.

How.note: How fast an alert reaches the ground depends on the communication link: the next ground station pass, a relay, or a wider ground network. Tiefer makes the alert small enough to use whichever comes first.

lab.title: Tiefer Lab
lab.text: Train, quantise and test models in a virtual orbit simulator and on flight-like hardware before anything flies.

ground.title: Tiefer Ground
ground.text: Run the same models at the ground station today. When your satellites carry Tiefer, the same code moves to orbit.

Demo.label: 04 / ALERT PACKET
Demo.title: An alert, not an archive.
Demo.body: When Tiefer finds an event, the satellite does not send the whole scene. It sends what an operator needs to act, and keeps the rest on board until someone asks for it. Every packet says what was observed and what was inferred.

fullScene.name: Full scene
fullScene.value: Kept on board. Downlink on request.

observed.name: Observed
observed.value: Active fire front, about 1.2 km long.

inferred.name: Inferred
inferred.value: Likely spread to the north-east. Confidence: medium.

UseCases.label: 05 / USE CASES
UseCases.title: Built for events where hours matter

wildfires.label: EVENT 01
wildfires.title: Wildfires
wildfires.text: Spot active fires in forests and grasslands and alert emergency services while the fire is still small.

oilSpills.label: EVENT 02
oilSpills.title: Oil spills
oilSpills.text: Flag slicks around offshore platforms and shipping lanes for rapid response.

maritime.label: EVENT 03
maritime.title: Maritime awareness
maritime.text: Detect vessels at sea; match them with AIS on the ground to find ships that are not broadcasting.

floods.label: EVENT 04
floods.title: Floods and reservoirs
floods.text: Track rising water and reservoir levels during flood season.

UseCases.note: We start with operators in Azerbaijan and the wider region, and work in English, Azerbaijani, Turkish and Russian.

p1.text: Filtered frames are compressed and kept. The operator sets the rules.

p2.text: Every alert labels the two separately, with a confidence value.

p3.text: Generated imagery is never sent as evidence.

p4.text: Every model in orbit is signed, versioned and can be rolled back.

p5.text: We publish accuracy, latency and power figures with the method behind them.

p6.text: Tiefer is not used to track individuals. Customers are screened.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.text: Cloud filter and three event models, measured on flight-like hardware in a virtual orbit.

groundPilot.title: Ground pilot
groundPilot.text: Tiefer Ground at an operator's ground segment.

firstFlight.title: First flight
firstFlight.text: Tiefer models running in orbit on a hosted compute platform.

nationalSatellites.title: National satellites
nationalSatellites.text: Tiefer on board operator satellites, agreed with the manufacturer.

region.title: Region
region.text: More operators, more events, radar data on board.

Name.label: 08 / NAME
Name.body: A camera records the surface. An analyst looks deeper. We are putting the analyst in orbit.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How the Tiefer website handles personal data: no cookies, no analytics, no requests to other servers from your browser.
privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data this website processes, why, and what rights you have. It covers this website and its contact form, and is structured to address the Law of the Republic of Azerbaijan on Personal Data of 11 May 2010 and, for visitors in the European Union, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

what-this-website-does-not-do.title: What this website does not do

list.l1: It does not set cookies and stores nothing in your browser.
list.l2: It does not use analytics, tracking pixels or advertising.
list.l3: Your browser loads nothing from other servers. The pages are built on our server, and the fonts, the stylesheet and the script come from the same server.
list.l4: It does not embed social media. The LinkedIn link is a plain link: LinkedIn receives data only if you follow it.

paras.p1: The website runs on Microsoft Azure: Azure Front Door and its web application firewall receive every request and pass it to Azure App Service, which runs the website. To deliver the pages and to protect the website from attacks, these services process the IP address of every visitor together with technical data of the request, such as the time and the page requested.
paras.p2: The web application firewall keeps logs of the requests it inspects, including IP addresses, for {log_retention_days} days, and then deletes them. Legal basis: [LEGAL_BASIS_HOSTING].

paras.p1: For each request, our server records the time, the page requested, the response status, the response size and how long the response took. It does not record IP addresses, and it never records what you write in the contact form.
paras.p2: To protect the contact form from abuse, the server keeps the IP address of each sender (for IPv6, only its network part) in memory for up to one hour, to limit the number of messages per connection. It is never written to disk or to a log, and it is gone when the server restarts.

paras.p1: If you use the contact form, we receive your name, your work email address, your organisation and role if you give them, your message, and your confirmation that we may reply.
paras.p2: We use these details to reply to you and to discuss working together.
paras.p3: The website does not store your message in a database. It sends it by email, through our email provider {smtp_provider} ({smtp_country}), to our mailbox, and keeps no copy on the web server.
paras.p4: If you email us directly, we receive your email address and what you write.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use policy
acceptableUse.description: How Tiefer may and may not be used.
acceptableUse.intro: Tiefer detects events in satellite imagery to support human decisions. This policy sets out what it may not be used for. It applies to every pilot, account and deployment. [AUP_SCOPE: confirm how this policy becomes part of customer contracts.]

list.l1: Every alert labels what was observed separately from what was inferred, with a confidence value.
list.l2: Generated imagery is never sent as evidence.
list.l3: Every model in orbit is signed, versioned and can be rolled back.
list.l4: Alerts support human decisions; they do not replace them.

list.l1: Tracking, identifying or profiling individual people.
list.l2: Any use that violates human rights.
list.l3: Any use that breaches applicable sanctions or export control rules. [SANCTIONS_REGIMES: list the sanctions and export control regimes Tiefer applies.]
list.l4: Selecting targets for attack or planning violence.
list.l5: Presenting inferred findings as observed facts.
list.l6: Using satellite imagery against the licence terms of its provider.

paras.p1: We screen every customer before granting access, including against sanctions lists, and we may ask how Tiefer will be used. We may decline any request. [SCREENING_PROCESS: describe the screening steps.]
We may suspend or end access if we believe this policy has been broken. [ENFORCEMENT_TERMS: align with customer contracts.]
If you believe Tiefer is being misused, write to <email>{contact_email}</email>.
